title: Reporting boundaries and sealed snapshots preserve what was actually assessed
summary: Live reporting views select immutable journals. A sealed ReportingSnapshot freezes the exact boundary, selected lines and source-book cutoffs so a regulator-facing report can later prove which accounting population was assessed without creating new accounting truth.
invariants: Reporting can span books/legal entities while retaining every line's legalEntityId and bookId; this is not consolidation.
A sealed snapshot freezes exact entry/line fingerprints and ordered source-book cutoffs.
VALID means source journals still match the sealed state; VALID_SOURCE_ADVANCED means later journals exist but none entered the sealed population.
REPORT_POPULATION_STALE means later/backdated evidence would now enter that population; the old snapshot remains immutable evidence of what was originally reported.
Reporting boundaries do not perform eliminations, tax determination or regulator-specific substantive tests.
Currency remains part of every reporting aggregation key.

provenance.claim: Sealed snapshot freezes exact selected population and distinguishes VALID, VALID_SOURCE_ADVANCED and REPORT_POPULATION_STALE.
ReportingBoundary selects immutable accounting evidence across exact dimensions without reposting or redefining legal entities.
